comparison.objective: Candidate classifies a mixed batch by passing media through apertures while retaining washers; record levels a sand bed with a screed riding on rails.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests selective granular passage, orientation-dependent bridging and controlled agitation; record tests maintaining two-rail contact while shaving and redistributing a deformable granular surface.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures receiver recovery mass and retained workpieces with immutable spill/loss; record measures bed depth uniformity, bridged pull, surface disturbance, board stowage and release.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared granular-material primitive, but selective aperture flow and bridge clearing are meaningfully different from producing a flat graded surface.
